name: Cisco Certified Network Associate (v2.0)
realExamNote: Built for CCNA v2.0 (testing from February 3, 2027); most topics also apply to v1.1, which retires February 2, 2027. The real exam is 120 minutes and includes simulations; the practice exams here are multiple choice only.
scoreNote: Cisco doesn't publish an official passing score; 825 of 1000 is the commonly cited target.
